text:
Jordan: FYI — NimbleClinic trial is blocked at onboarding step 3. Users hit intermittent 401s when exchanging OIDC token. Ticket SUP-9876 created. Customer mentions renewal review next week, marking as high priority :exclamation:
Priya: thanks Jordan. Can you paste the error log and the exact steps they hit? I’ll prep comms if this is a renewal risk :eyes:
Jordan: quick logs from their session:
```
2026-03-22T14:08:12Z ERROR token_exchange failed status=401 ctx=nonce-mismatch
2026-03-22T14:08:13Z WARN retry token refresh attempt=2
```
Jordan: steps: (1) customer hits onboarding UI -> (2) our frontend calls /auth/exchange -> (3) 401 returned -> visible in onboarding flow and they can’t complete billing attach. Happened ~10x across two seats.
Devin: looks like a nonce race we saw before after the last SDK patch. Can you confirm SDK version? Jordan: they’re on sdk-js v1.4.0 (from support form).
Devin: ok that’s the older flow. There was a hotfix in v1.4.3 that serializes nonce refresh. I can patch their tenant tomorrow but need a repro or we can apply a server-side mitigation now.
Priya: timeline? If we can patch tomorrow that’s cutting it close for renewal. I’ll start drafting an email to the customer with an honest comms plan.
Alex: I can run a short enablement call to walk them through a temporary client-side workaround (clear local storage + refresh) while engineering stages the patch. Offer a 1:1 session today or tomorrow.
Jordan: customer prefers today afternoon (they’re PST). I dropped a calendar invite to their admin and copied dev contact.
Devin: immediate mitigation: enable server-side nonce toleration flag for their tenant to accept nonce-window=+2 for 24 hours. I’ll flip it and follow up with rollback notes. Doing it now.
OpsBot: deploy flagged: feature.toggle.nonce_tolerance set to true for tenant=nimbleclinic (by Devin)
Devin: toggled. Please confirm NimbleClinic can continue onboarding.
Jordan: they report onboarding progressed to step 4 after the change. :thumbsup:
Priya: thanks all. Drafted comms: short apology, what we changed (temporary tolerance), next steps (patch scheduled, rollback plan), offer enablement call, and a 10% procedural credit for their trouble ahead of renewal. Posting draft below for review — please keep edits minimal, want to send in the hour.
Priya: "Hi Ana (NimbleClinic), we’re sorry for the onboarding interruption. We applied a temporary server-side tolerance to unblock your users while we roll a fix. Our engineering team will deploy a permanent patch by tomorrow and we’ll follow up when it’s live. In the meantime we can run a 30-min walkthrough to finish setup. As a gesture, we’ll provide a 10% account credit for this billing period. — Priya, Customer Success"
Devin: LGTM re tech details. Recommend removing exact flag name and use "temporary server-side change" in the customer-facing email.
Alex: I’ll host the walkthrough. Please send the calendar invite and confirm attendee emails.
Priya: sent invite to Ana + platform engineer. Jordan — can you add the support ticket link and a short list of the repro steps to the calendar event?
Jordan: done — SUP-9876 link added and steps pasted in event notes.
Priya: final comms sent to customer 16:40 PST. Customer replied: "Thanks — we can finish onboarding now. Appreciate the quick patch and offer for a call tomorrow."
Priya: tracking items: 1) Deploy permanent patch v1.4.3 -> assigned to Devin; ETA 2026-03-23 10:00 PT, 2) Rollback temp flag after patch -> Devin, 3) Follow-up email post-patch -> Priya, 4) Enablement call run -> Alex.
Devin: will push patch tomorrow morning and post release notes.
Jordan: closing the support ticket as workaround verified. Marking customer health as at-risk -> improved after mitigation.
Priya: will note renewal RISK -> moved to "priority outreach" and schedule a check-in with account owner after patch. Thanks team :heart:
